result.markdown:
# Power Failure and Site Outage at S-SFX-010

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-SFX-010`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence (MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, SITE_DOWN) matches the KPI drops and anomaly window precisely. Maintenance and changes were checked and ruled out. External events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-22 17:00 to 2026-09-22 20:58
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-22 13:21
- **Affected:** S-SFX-010

## Summary

A mains power failure occurred at site S-SFX-010, leading to battery depletion and subsequent site downtime.

Site S-SFX-010 experienced a total loss of availability and active users starting at 17:00 on 2026-09-22 due to power loss, lasting until full recovery at 20:58 when all alarms cleared.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-22 13:21: Major MAINS_FAILURE raised on S-SFX-010 [ALM-000484]
- 2026-09-22 16:46: Major BATTERY_LOW raised on S-SFX-010 [ALM-000486]
- 2026-09-22 17:00: Traffic, active users and availability drop anomaly onset on S-SFX-010 [ALR-0033, ANM-000266, ANM-000267, ANM-000268]
- 2026-09-22 17:01: Critical SITE_DOWN raised on S-SFX-010 [ALM-000488]
- 2026-09-22 20:58: All alarms (MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, SITE_DOWN) cleared on S-SFX-010, marking recovery [ALM-000484, ALM-000486, ALM-000488]

## Evidence

- Site S-SFX-010 lost availability and active users down to 0 from 2026-09-22 17:00 to 2026-09-22 21:00. [ALR-0033, ANM-000266, ANM-000267]
- Mains failure occurred at 13:21, followed by low battery at 16:46 and site down at 17:01 on S-SFX-010. [ALM-000484, ALM-000486, ALM-000488]
- No maintenance windows or configuration changes were scheduled or performed on S-SFX-010 or its parent nodes during the incident window. [T4, T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-SFX-010: confirmed. Directly evidenced by mains failure, battery low, and site down alarms matching the exact timeframe of the traffic and availability drops. [ALM-000484, ALM-000486, ALM-000488, ALR-0033]

## Ruled out

- ALR-0034: Ongoing alert starting 2026-09-23 09:15 affecting different site entities (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-011) in a different region/scope, unrelated to the S-SFX-010 outage.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect site power supply and backup battery systems at S-SFX-010.

## Sources

- `ALM-000484`: major MAINS_FAILURE on S-SFX-010, raised 2026-09-22 13:21, cleared 2026-09-22 20:58
- `ALM-000486`: major BATTERY_LOW on S-SFX-010, raised 2026-09-22 16:46, cleared 2026-09-22 20:58
